item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json,copy,work; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); got=[work.evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; exp=json.load(open('report.json')); assert got==exp,(got,exp); cases=[({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'a','meta':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'a','meta':2},'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'q'}}},{'ignored':['y']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})];\\nfor r,p,e in cases:\\n rc,pc=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p); assert work.evaluate(r,p)==e; assert r==rc and p==pc\\nprint('ok')\"]}"}
